import datetime

import pytest
from freezegun.api import _parse_tz_offset


@pytest.mark.kriya_requirement("REQ-1")
def test_plus_offset_string():
    assert _parse_tz_offset("+05:30") == datetime.timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30)


@pytest.mark.kriya_requirement("REQ-1")
def test_minus_offset_string():
    assert _parse_tz_offset("-02:00") == datetime.timedelta(hours=-2)


@pytest.mark.kriya_requirement("REQ-1")
def test_any_other_string_raises_value_error():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        _parse_tz_offset("abc")
